name: ai.toolsenabled/tesi-agent-api
title: TESI Agent Computer (1–8 vCPU Linux + Chrome)
description: Cloud Linux computer with Chrome (1-8 vCPU) for AI agents over MCP. Free $2.50 trial, no card.

tools.name: tesi_discover
tools.description: Fetch the keyless TESI Agent API catalog covering pricing ($2.50 no-card trial, $10-$100 packs), 1-8 vCPU specs, endpoints, and starter templates. Returns JSON containing status, pricing tiers, endpoints, and starter templates. Example: {"full": false}.

full.description: Set true for full /api/v1/agents catalog; default false returns compact quickstart.

tools.name: tesi_quote
tools.description: Calculate a keyless starting-credit and USD pack quote for a planned Ask or Work prompt without spending credits. Returns JSON with minimumAvailablePico, eligible USD pack options, and optional reference call cost. Example: {"message": "Generate a formula-checked Excel budget workbook", "mode": "work"}.

message.description: Planned prompt text to measure UTF-8 byte length for starting credit (aliases: prompt, text, task, query).
examples: Build a tested FastAPI service and run pytest

promptBytes.description: Exact UTF-8 prompt byte count when quoting without sending prompt text.

mode.description: Target turn mode: ask (read-only) or work (execution/deliverables).

effort.description: Effort tier: auto lets TESI size the effort to the job; auto-fast and auto-ultrafast also run more agents at once and use credit faster; low, medium, high, xhigh, max and ultra fix the depth.

inputTokens.description: Optional sample input token count to compute reference call cost.

outputTokens.description: Optional sample output token count to compute reference call cost.

tools.name: tesi_shortlist_work
tools.description: Search and filter built-in TESI Work starter tasks that fit inside a credit budget or your active key balance. Returns JSON listing matching starter tasks, credit thresholds, and prepare arguments. Example: {"budgetCredits": "2.50"}.

budgetCredits.description: Decimal TESI credit budget (e.g. "2.50" or "10.00") to filter eligible sample tasks.

tools.name: tesi_balance
tools.description: Read spendable prepaid credits on your bearer key or auto-authenticated MCP session while reconciling pending Stripe top-ups. Returns JSON with availablePico, creditPico, usedPico, and optional rolling usage window totals. Example: {"windowHours": 24}.

windowHours.description: Optional rolling lookback window in hours (1-744) to include recent spend totals.

tools.name: tesi_usage
tools.description: List itemized settled credit debits on your key with cursor pagination for spend audits. Returns JSON with charges array, debitCredits total, and nextCursor token. Example: {"limit": 25}.

limit.description: Maximum number of settled charge rows to return (1-100).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous tesi_usage call.

windowHours.description: Optional rolling lookback window in hours (1-744) for aggregate totals.

tools.name: tesi_plan_topup
tools.description: Check whether your key balance covers a planned prompt and calculate any needed credit top-up without opening Stripe Checkout. Returns JSON with meetsStartingCredit boolean and recommendedAmountCents. Example: {"promptBytes": 1200}.

message.description: Planned prompt text to check against your current key balance (aliases: prompt, text, task, query).
examples: Run Playwright visual QA on https://example.com

promptBytes.description: Exact UTF-8 prompt byte count when checking balance without sending text.

tools.name: tesi_prepare_purchase
tools.description: Create or preview a one-time Stripe Checkout session ($10-$100 USD, $0/mo) to fund a brand-new TESI bearer key. Returns JSON with sessionId, checkoutUrl, amountCents, and pack preview metadata. Example: {"amountCents": 1000, "quoteOnly": true}.

quoteOnly.description: Set true to preview pack specs and browser link without creating a Stripe session.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for the new bearer key (up to 80 chars).

purchaseId.description: Optional 64-hex client idempotency token enabling crash-safe key recovery on tesi_claim_key.

tools.name: tesi_claim_key
tools.description: Create or redeem a reusable tesi_ak_... bearer key from a free $2.50 no-card trial (trial: true; one per network), completed Stripe sessionId, or giftCode, and auto-bind the current Mcp-Session-Id for 24h. Returns JSON with apiKey, keyId, funding source, creditCents, and sessionAuthenticated flag. Example: {"trial": true, "label": "my-agent"}.

trial.description: Set true to mint a free $2.50 USD trial key with no credit card (1 per subnet per 30 days).

label.description: Optional human-readable label for the minted bearer key.

sessionId.description: Completed Stripe Checkout session ID (cs_live_...) from tesi_prepare_purchase.

purchaseId.description: Matching 64-hex purchaseId passed to tesi_prepare_purchase for idempotent recovery.

giftCode.description: Issued promotional gift code to preview or redeem without a card.

preview.description: Set true with trial or giftCode to check eligibility/credit amount without claiming.

tools.name: tesi_prepare_topup
tools.description: Create or reconcile a same-key Stripe Checkout top-up ($10-$100 USD) that adds credits to your existing key while keeping workspace files intact. Returns JSON with checkoutUrl, sessionId, addedCents, and updated balance. Example: {"amountCents": 2500}.

sessionId.description: Existing top-up Stripe session ID (cs_live_...) to reconcile immediately.

recoverOnly.description: Set true to recover or reconcile an open top-up session without opening a new one.

tools.name: tesi_ask
tools.description: FREE $2.50 NO-CARD TRIAL (one per network; zero auth headers needed — auto-activates on first call): Run a read-only Q&A, code review, or data analysis turn on an isolated 1-8 vCPU cloud Linux computer (or your consented workspace when signed in via OAuth 2.1 PKCE) with idempotent requestId recovery. Accepts message, prompt, text, task, or query. Returns JSON with reply text, replySha256, deliverable envelope, requestId, usage summary, and remaining balance. Example: {"message": "Summarize schema diffs in /home/user/workspace/schema.sql", "effort": "low"}.

message.description: Read-only question, review brief, or analysis request (UTF-8 text; aliases: prompt, text, task, query).

effort.description: Reasoning depth: auto lets TESI size the effort to the job; auto-fast and auto-ultrafast also run more agents at once and use credit faster; low, medium, high, xhigh, max and ultra fix the depth.

requestId.description: Optional caller-generated idempotency ID (mw_ + 32 hex) for crash-safe receipt recovery.

wait.description: Default true (waits for completion). Set false to return requestId immediately and poll with tesi_receipt(waitSeconds: 45).

allowAutoTopupCheckout.description: Default false (returns manual 402 guidance); set true to auto-create a top-up Checkout URL if balance is low.

useKnowledge.description: Include account-scoped personalized Knowledge for your consented workspace (requires knowledge:read_write scope).

knowledgeNote.description: Append a personalized Knowledge note to your consented workspace (requires knowledge:read_write scope).

vaultSite.description: Perform an opaque TEVault session/sign-in check inside your consented workspace with zero secret egress (requires vault:use scope).

tools.name: tesi_work
tools.description: FREE $2.50 NO-CARD TRIAL (one per network; zero auth headers needed — auto-activates on first call): Run an autonomous software build, test suite, PDF/Excel/PPTX generation, or Playwright Chrome QA task on an isolated 1-8 vCPU cloud Linux + Chrome computer (or your consented workspace when signed in via OAuth 2.1 PKCE). Pass wait: false for multi-minute builds and poll with tesi_receipt(requestId, waitSeconds: 45) to avoid client timeouts. Accepts message, prompt, text, task, or query. Example: {"message": "Build report.xlsx with SUM formulas and verify with LibreOffice", "acceptanceChecks": ["Zero formula errors"], "effort": "medium", "wait": false}.

message.description: Concrete task specification describing desired files, code, tests, or browser checks (aliases: prompt, text, task, query).
examples: Build a tested CSV reconciliation CLI in Python and verify with pytest

acceptanceChecks.description: Optional list of verifiable pass/fail acceptance criteria TESI must run and report before finishing.

effort.description: Execution effort: auto lets TESI size the effort to the job; auto-fast and auto-ultrafast also run more agents at once and use credit faster; low, medium, high, xhigh, max and ultra fix the depth.

requestId.description: Optional caller-generated idempotency ID (mw_ + 32 hex) for crash-safe receipt recovery via tesi_receipt.

wait.description: Default true (waits for completion). Set false for long builds, tests, or Playwright QA to return requestId immediately, then poll with tesi_receipt(requestId, waitSeconds: 45).

allowAutoTopupCheckout.description: Default false (returns manual 402 guidance); set true to auto-create a top-up Checkout URL if balance is low.

useKnowledge.description: Include account-scoped personalized Knowledge for your consented workspace (requires knowledge:read_write scope).

knowledgeNote.description: Append a personalized Knowledge note to your consented workspace (requires knowledge:read_write scope).

vaultSite.description: Perform an opaque TEVault session/sign-in check inside your consented workspace with zero secret egress (requires vault:use scope).

tools.name: tesi_receipt
tools.description: Retrieve or long-poll a saved Ask/Work turn reply and SHA-256 hash by requestId with zero extra spend, or list recent turn receipts. Pass waitSeconds (up to 50) when following an async wait:false job. Example: {"requestId": "mw_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", "waitSeconds": 45}.

requestId.description: Specific turn requestId (mw_ + 32 hex) to fetch, long-poll, or recover.

waitSeconds.description: Optional long-poll timeout in seconds (0-50) while a turn is processing. Returns immediately once ready.

listReceipts.description: Set true to list recent turn receipts instead of fetching a single requestId.

mode.description: Optional mode filter (ask or work) when listing receipts.

delivery.description: Optional delivery status filter (ready or unresolved) when listing receipts.

limit.description: Maximum receipts per page when listing (1-100).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor requestId returned by a previous listReceipts call.

tools.name: tesi_files_list
tools.description: List files and directories inside your key's isolated 4-100 GB TESI workspace with sizes, SHA-256 digests, and version tokens. Returns JSON with folder path and file entry metadata array. Example: {"folder": "/home/user/workspace"}.

tools.name: tesi_upload_file
tools.description: Create and save input datasets, PDFs, CSVs, archives, or source files inside your key's isolated TESI computer before calling tesi_work or tesi_ask so TESI processes them at $0 prompt-token cost. Writes binary (contentBase64) or UTF-8 (contentUtf8) files (up to 768 KiB inline; up to 50 MiB via /api/v1/agents/files/upload) and returns JSON with saved path, version token, byte length, and sha256 digest. Example: {"fileName": "orders.csv", "contentUtf8": "id,amount\n1,42\n"}.

fileName.description: Target filename inside the folder (no path traversal, e.g. data.xlsx).

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded binary payload (PDF, XLSX, PNG, ZIP, CSV, etc.).

contentUtf8.description: Plain UTF-8 file text when uploading text/CSV/JSON.

tools.name: tesi_download_file
tools.description: Fetch and retrieve a versioned binary or text artifact (.xlsx, .pdf, .pptx, .png, .zip) from your key's isolated TESI workspace. Returns JSON with path, version, sha256 digest, and verified contentBase64 payload or streaming endpoint metadata. Example: {"path": "/home/user/workspace/report.pdf", "version": "v1-1-2-3-4-5"}.

version.description: File version token returned by tesi_files_list.

includeBase64.description: Default true (returns verified contentBase64 up to 1 MiB); set false for streaming endpoint metadata.

tools.name: tesi_knowledge
tools.description: Read, search, or write personalized workspace Knowledge notes pinned to your consented TESI account and workspace (requires OAuth 2.1 PKCE knowledge:read_write scope for account workspaces; returns an empty isolated view on anonymous trial). Example: {"action": "list"}.

action.description: Knowledge operation: list (default), search, or write.

query.description: Optional substring query when searching workspace Knowledge notes.

title.description: Title when writing a workspace Knowledge note.

content.description: Note content when writing to workspace Knowledge.

tools.name: tesi_vault_use
tools.description: Perform an opaque TEVault session check or sign-in inside your consented TESI workspace with strictly zero raw secret egress (requires OAuth 2.1 PKCE vault:use scope; returns status, site, operation, and opaqueResultId only — passwords, cookies, and keys are never returned). Example: {"operation": "status"}.

operation.description: Opaque TEVault operation: status (default) or sign_in.

site.description: Target site domain for opaque session check or sign-in (e.g. "github.com").

tools.name: tesi_whoami
tools.description: Inspect your connected TESI identity, active workspace, available workspaces (when signed in via OAuth 2.1 PKCE), current credit balance, granted scopes, and workspace links. Free read-only call (0 credits). Example: {}.

tools.name: tesi_read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 source, Markdown, log, JSON, or CSV file directly from your TESI workspace by path without needing a version token (supports optional 1-based startLine/endLine slicing; free read-only call, 0 credits). Binary files return metadata and their version token for tesi_download_file. Example: {"path": "/home/user/workspace/README.md", "startLine": 1, "endLine": 120}.

tools.name: tesi_workspace_widget
tools.description: Render the interactive TESI Workspace Console (MCP App UI) showing live credit balance, active/recent TESI builds and SHA-256 receipts, workspace files, and a direct link to open the full cloud Linux + Chrome computer desktop. Free read-only call (0 credits). Example: {}.

requestId.description: Optional specific turn requestId to highlight in the console.
